## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural change.

## Validation

- [ ] Bootstrap/content validation passes.
- [ ] Godot headless import passes.
- [ ] Web export passes.
- [ ] Browser smoke passes.
- [ ] Desktop preview checked.
- [ ] Mobile landscape preview checked when applicable.
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated.
- [ ] No portal SDK was called directly from gameplay.
- [ ] No unlicensed third-party asset was added.

## Playable testing

For playable/visual changes, wait for the automated **Playable PR Preview** comment and test that exact URL.

> Do not merge until the project owner explicitly approves the PR.
